page.title: OurTaikoPlay · Every beat, together
page.description: OurTaikoPlay is an open-source taiko rhythm game with a Nijiiro-style interface, keyboard and touch controls, local TJA charts and online libraries. Download for Windows or Android, or join iOS TestFlight.
nav.label: Main navigation
hero.description1: An open-source taiko rhythm game with a familiar Nijiiro feel.
hero.description2: Play with a keyboard or touch controls. Browse online libraries or bring your own TJA charts.
features.intro1: From your first Don to your next full combo.
features.intro2: Enjoy every song at your own pace.
features.skin1: Song panels, nameplates, soul gauges and results
features.skin2: bring the familiar taiko atmosphere to your device.
features.input: Keyboard or touch. Ready to play.
features.input1: Use your keyboard on desktop or on-screen drums on mobile.
features.input2: Don and Ka: let your hands follow the music.
features.library1: Load local TJA charts or connect to Fanmade and ESE.
features.library2: Browse songs, download charts and track your progress.
features.practice1: Pause or restart whenever you like. Adjust speed and play options
features.practice2: to practice your favorite songs at your own pace.
download.intro: Actively in development. Nightly builds are available for Windows and Android; join the iOS beta through TestFlight.
download.androidNote: Download and install on your device
download.note: Windows and Android buttons open the Nightly release page. Choose your package under Assets. Nightly builds may contain unresolved issues.
community.title: Need help or want to chat?
community.description: Join “OurTaiko先行版！” on QQ to share your plays and feedback.
guide.installText: Choose your platform above. Extract and run on Windows, install the APK on Android, or install TestFlight first on iPhone and iPad.
guide.songsText: Sign in or connect to an online server as a guest. You can also place local TJA charts and their audio in the game’s Songs folder.
guide.playText: Choose a song and difficulty, then play with your keyboard or on-screen drums. Want another try? Pause or restart anytime.
